messages:
maya_pd: noticed a wording mismatch during the QA demo: the help panel on the Dataset page says 'Data Routes' but docs use 'Data Endpoints' — customers got thrown off.

jules_docs: thanks, can you paste the exact panel copy?

maya_pd: panel header: 'Data Routes' and the inline link text 'Learn about Data Endpoints'. tiny but confusing.

ryan_eng: is there any functional difference? backend calls them endpoints in the API layer. sounds like UI drift.

leo_ux: design history: 'Data Routes' was an exploratory label we used in the earlier nav. we should converge to 'Data Endpoints' for consistency. UX suggestion: keep 'Data Endpoints' as primary and show 'aka Routes' as microcopy on first-run help.

jules_docs: i'll add an anchor #data-endpoints and a tiny prefatory line: "Data Endpoints (previously called Data Routes in the console)." then link the panel directly to that anchor.

paul_pm: accessibility ask: if we add an 'aka' microcopy, ensure it's readable by screen readers and doesn't clutter. @a11y-bot any guidance?

a11y-bot: microcopy should be visible text (not only tooltip). If it's supplementary, mark with aria-describedby and ensure keyboard focus order includes the help link. Avoid relying on color alone.

ryan_eng: I'll update the console help builder to use DOCS_BASE + '/data/endpoints#data-endpoints' and to include aria-label on the link. I'll also add a synonym in the in-app search index so 'routes' returns the endpoint doc.

jules_docs: docs PR plan: add anchor, prefatory sentence, and a short note for two weeks saying 'Console label: Data Routes (legacy)'.

leo_ux: rollout plan: 1) change console label to 'Data Endpoints' but keep a small 'legacy: Routes' hint 2) update docs anchor and redirect 3) search synonyms. small banner in release notes.

maya_pd: sounds good. owners: ryan for console change, jules for docs, leo for microcopy, paul for release note. target: tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:

paul_pm: i'll track in the release board and confirm once PRs merge.
